title: Étale Fundamental Group: from loops to covers to Galois symmetry
summary: A geometric laboratory for the étale fundamental group, following Szamuely's Galois Groups and Fundamental Groups. Every computation is drawn first: the Riemann sphere and stereographic projection, 𝔸¹ as the sphere minus ∞, 𝔾ₘ as a twice-punctured sphere, punctured plane or cylinder with explicit n-sheeted covers z ↦ zⁿ, ℙ¹ − {0,1,∞} as a pair of pants, genus 0 to 4 surfaces with punctures and the 4g-gon fold, elliptic curves as cubic, lattice and torus with their torsion grids, and Spec ℂ, Spec ℝ and Spec 𝔽_q with Frobenius necklaces. Synchronised geometry, cover, fibre and group panels share one monodromy animation, computed by lifting loops numerically through the covering equations. A characteristic-p view shows Artin–Schreier sheets and ordinary versus supersingular torsion towers; an arithmetic view shows Galois acting on roots of unity. With a profinite tower, a dessin teaser, puzzles, a command palette, a presentation mode and a narrated beamdswitch deck.
